_readme: Coffee Compass content file. Fill in each venue's stars, praise and tags here, save, then run Publish.command. The live app reads this on every load, so your edits appear without rebuilding the app. Match each venue by its id (do not change the ids).

_howto.stars: A whole number 1 to 5, your rating as the auditor. Use null until you have visited.
_howto.praise: One honest line in your own voice. Empty string until you have a verdict.
_howto.tags: Pick any that apply from _allowedTags below. Order does not matter; crew-discount is highlighted automatically.
